profile.summary: The East Bay Consortium is one of sixteen California Student Opportunity and Access Programs (Cal-SOAP) administered by the California Student Aid Commission. Established in 1978, it works to increase the number of students who finish high school and enroll in college. It offers tutoring, mentoring, summer academic programs, financial aid workshops and teacher training, mainly in Oakland.
